google.plugin.title: Google
google.plugin.summary: Brings in data from your Google account: Calendar (private iCal address, read-only, shown in the calendar and checked live when you ask about your schedule), Gmail (app password, read-only, searched and read live when you ask; optionally imports the mail you send) and Contacts (an exported vCard dropped into the import folder goes to the profile review card)
google.plugin.purge.calendar: Synced Google Calendar events and calendar names
google.plugin.purge.addresses: The private iCal addresses you entered (in this computer's secrets area)
google.plugin.purge.gmail: Imported mail you sent (only if Import was on)
google.plugin.purge.gmailPassword: The Gmail address and app password you entered (in this computer's secrets area)
google.plugin.keep.materials: Material made from the mail you sent: material belongs to the core; to delete it use bulk delete in Memory · Material (Settings · Delete material when the memory plugin is off)
google.plugin.keep.backup: The copy in backup snapshots (gone as snapshots rotate)
google.calendar.title: Google · Calendar
google.calendar.summary: Your Google Calendar's private iCal address (read-only, no Google Cloud project needed): events are fetched regularly and shown in the calendar, and checked live when you ask about your schedule
google.calendar.destination: shown in the calendar (read-only), not added to material
google.calendar.calendarOff: {reason}: synced events don't show in the calendar for now (syncing and lookups still work)
google.calendar.disconnectNote: The synced Google events no longer show in Ergo's calendar; Google Calendar itself is untouched.
google.calendar.noSuchFeed: No such calendar (it may already be removed)
google.calendar.address.empty: Enter a private iCal address first
google.calendar.address.bad: That isn't a web address: paste the whole "Secret address in iCal format" from Google Calendar settings
google.calendar.address.notHttps: The address must start with https://
google.calendar.fetch.gone: The address no longer works (Google returned {status}): the private address may have been reset in Google Calendar; copy the "Secret address in iCal format" again from its settings
google.calendar.fetch.denied: Not allowed to read this calendar (Google returned {status}): use the "Secret address in iCal format"; for work or school accounts an admin may have turned this off
google.calendar.fetch.http: Couldn't fetch the calendar (Google returned {status}); try again later
google.calendar.fetch.notCalendar: This address didn't return a calendar: copy the "Secret address in iCal format" (ending in .ics)
google.calendar.fetch.tooBig: The calendar is too large (over {mb} MB)
google.calendar.fetch.timeout: Fetching the calendar timed out (not done in {seconds} seconds)
google.gmail.title: Google · Gmail
google.gmail.summary: Connects read-only to your mailbox with a Gmail app password (IMAP): searches and reads mail live when asked, never sends, deletes or changes read status; can optionally import the mail you send
google.gmail.destination: imports only the mail you send (your own words, quoted text removed) as material; received mail is not imported
google.gmail.address.bad: That isn't an email address (it should look like name@gmail.com)
google.gmail.password.empty: Enter an app password (the 16 letters from your Google account's "App passwords" page)
google.gmail.error.auth: Couldn't sign in to Gmail: the address or app password is wrong. Use an app password (16 letters), not your Google account password; changing your Google password revokes all app passwords, so create a new one
google.gmail.error.needAppPassword: Gmail requires an app password: turn on 2-Step Verification for your Google account, then create an app password and enter it here (not your Google password)
google.gmail.error.webLogin: Google blocked this sign-in: sign in to Gmail once in a browser to confirm it's you, then try again
google.gmail.error.tls: Gmail's certificate didn't check out ({code}): a proxy or the network may be intercepting it
google.gmail.error.timeout: Connecting to Gmail timed out (no response in {seconds} seconds)
google.gmail.error.closed: Gmail closed the connection; try again later
google.gmail.error.stale: The mailbox's message IDs changed: search again, then read
google.gmail.error.notFound: No such message (it may have been deleted or moved)
google.gmail.error.notConfigured: No Gmail address and app password yet
google.plugin.keep.files: What's already in personal profiles, and suggestions still waiting for review (to delete those, first delete what Google · Contacts imported in Settings · Data sources)
google.contacts.title: Google · Contacts
google.contacts.summary: Drop a vCard (.vcf) exported from Google Contacts into the import folder: people with a birthday, anniversary or relationship, and people who already have a profile, become profile suggestions you confirm one by one; nothing goes into memory
google.contacts.destination: goes to the profile review card (written only after you confirm), not into material
google.contacts.disconnectNote: Profile suggestions imported from Google Contacts that you haven't handled yet are dropped and their review cards updated; what's already in your profiles stays, and Google Contacts itself is untouched.
google.contacts.result.waiting: they go on a card once the previous review card is done
google.contacts.result.batched_one: {count} person on the card for now, the rest follow once it's done
google.contacts.result.batched_other: {count} people on the card for now, the rest follow once it's done
google.contacts.result.same_one: {count} person matches the profiles already, nothing to review
google.contacts.result.same_other: {count} people match the profiles already, nothing to review
google.contacts.result.repeated_one: {count} person was imported before with nothing new
google.contacts.result.repeated_other: {count} people were imported before with nothing new
google.contacts.result.skipped_one: {count} more person wasn't suggested (no birthday, anniversary or relationship, and no profile yet)
google.contacts.result.skipped_other: {count} more people weren't suggested (no birthday, anniversary or relationship, and no profile yet)
google.contacts.error.empty: No contacts found in this file (it should be a vCard exported from Google Contacts)
google.contacts.error.tooBig: The file is too big (over {mb} MB)
